description: A criterion universal over two hosts whose evidence falls in different accounting windows. Both hosts satisfy it in their own role, but no single window sees both, so no window can answer yes on its own. The window budget is declared small so a handful of files reproduces what took half a megabyte in production.

criteria.text: Each applicable host contains an explicit broker extension with conventional local routing disabled and topology appropriate to its publisher or consumer role.
criteria.because: Both installers declare DisableConventionalLocalRouting; the server declares publish routes for what it publishes and the worker declares a binding and a listener for what it consumes. Neither host is missing anything its role requires.
